<div class="mag-shell"><div class="mag-chrome mag-chrome-top"><div class="chrome-group"><span>WHAT CHANGED</span><span class="chrome-sep"></span><span>SYSTEM NOT PALETTE</span></div><div class="chrome-group chrome-right"><span>ACT I</span></div></div><div class="story-head"><div class="slide-kicker">NOT A RECOLOR</div><h1 class="section-title">这次重做的，是版式语法</h1><p class="section-body">旧版本的问题在于保留了 manuscript 的 framed page、plaque block 和 archive card 母结构。现在换成了更接近 Guizang 原版 deck 的 headline、stat spread、rowline 和 chapter rhythm。</p></div><div class="stat-grid"><section class="stat-card"><div class="stat-label">HERO</div><div class="stat-value">01</div><div class="stat-note">封面和幕封负责拉开节奏</div></section><section class="stat-card"><div class="stat-label">COMPONENTS</div><div class="stat-value">06</div><div class="stat-note">stat / rowline / pillar / quote</div></section><section class="stat-card"><div class="stat-label">SURFACES</div><div class="stat-value">03</div><div class="stat-note">dark theme / editorial card</div></section><section class="stat-card"><div class="stat-label">DELIVERABLES</div><div class="stat-value">05</div><div class="stat-note">核心模板同步改造</div></section></div><div class="rowline-list"><div class="rowline"><div class="rowline-title">Chrome</div><div class="rowline-body">页眉页脚回到杂志导航语义，而不是文档边框装饰。</div><div class="rowline-tag">META</div></div><div class="rowline"><div class="rowline-title">Hierarchy</div><div class="rowline-body">标题由衬线负责冲击，正文交给 sans，元信息交给 mono。</div><div class="rowline-tag">TYPE</div></div><div class="rowline"><div class="rowline-title">Rhythm</div><div class="rowline-body">HTML / PDF / PPT 都有 hero 页与正文页的明显节奏切换。</div><div class="rowline-tag">FLOW</div></div></div><div class="mag-chrome mag-chrome-bottom"><div class="chrome-group"><span>LANGUAGE SHIFT</span></div><div class="chrome-group chrome-right"><span>02 / 08</span></div></div></div>
